card.name: Inside organization and company names
card.fires_on: Later parts of multi-part organization or company names in general web text, such as Scholastic, Collins, Park Service, Farm Credit and PLATO Learning. It fires where the name is partway through and a further name part may follow.

modes.label: Company name parts
modes.description: A middle or later piece of a business or publisher name.

modes.label: Agency or institution names
modes.description: A noun inside a named body, just before the rest of the name.

card.plain: It marks a spot partway through the name of a company or institution, where more of the name is expected to follow.
